title: Ninja 9-Cup Food Processor for Kitchen, 1000PW motor, 9-Cup Processing Bowl, Multiple Blades and Adjustable Speed, for Chopping and Slicing Vegetables, Pureeing, and Mixing Dough, BZ601 Review
reviews: GREAT WORKHORSE!! AMAZING LITTLE WORKHORSE!!! EASY to operate, and clean!! GREAT CHOICE!!! Works much more efficiently than my last one..which was heavy and waaaay less efficient and triple the price! Thrilled with my purchase

Very Good Performance! Love it. Just used it for the first time. It did a great job chopping junks of beef - could make chop meat in no time. Nice and even chopping. Love the multiple blades and the chopping, pureeing options. The container is plenty big enough for my uses. It's everything I need.

Ninja Food Processor - a Real Game Changer From the moment I took it out of the box, I was impressed by how simple it was to set up; the instructions are easy to decipher, and every part clicks easily into place, effortlessly. Taking it apart for cleaning is just as easy — no struggling, no complicated latches, just a straightforward design. The controls are clear, the functions are powerful, and it handles everything...chopping, slicing, shredding, etc. I love that I can go from prep to cleanup in minutes, which makes cooking that much more enjoyable. This Ninja is sturdy and no worries about it moving off your counter when using; the suction cups are more than adequate. If you're looking for a reliable, easy-to-use/clean food processor, this Ninja is absolutely worth it!

Great I love this food processor. I bought it specifically to grind raw chicken breasts and thighs to make raw cat food. The two tier blade is perfect for this, and the blade housing isn't hollow like my old Cuisinart, so ground chicken doesn't squeeze into it and make a huge mess: cleanup is a breeze. Also, it's powerful, but quiet and lightweight. Super happy with this purchase!

Happy of the quality of the used product that I purchase I chose to buy the used product. And I am very happy with the results. The product was in very good condition as in like new no parts for missing.

Powerful, Compact, and Super Versatile Processor Bought this Ninja processor as a gift for my husband, and he absolutely loves it. He uses it all the time for making salsa, shredding cheese, preparing hummus, and even making dough. It’s very multifunctional and handles everything with ease. From a space perspective, it’s surprisingly compact and not heavy, which makes it easy to keep on the counter or store away. We also really appreciate the suction cups on the bottom — it stays firmly in place while in use and doesn’t move around at all. The wraparound cord storage in the back is another great feature that keeps everything neat and organized. Overall, another great product from Ninja. Highly practical, powerful, and used constantly in our kitchen.

Loving it! I have to confess that I was planning on keeping my Cuisinart forever, and just replacing the plastic parts as they broke. I was totally sure that no other food processor could be as good as it.... and I was totally wrong. A plastic safety feature broke off 2 days before Thanksgiving and I panicked because I couldn't find anyplace to get a new part in time. So I spent an hour or so reading reviews for other food processors and chose this one. I bought it from Amazon because they could deliver it the next day, whereas the closest store I could pick one up was 6 hours away. I am telling you this so you understand that this was a desperation purchase. But I could NOT be happier. The first thing I noticed was that the turning mechanism was NOT part of the base, so there was no hole in the bottom of the plastic bowl like I was used to. This means that when I turn it on, that initial surge wouldn't make stuff drip out of that center hole and get all over the food processor. It also means that if you want to soak it when you are done, the water won't be pouring out of that hole - you can fill the bowl totally up with water. The lid has a gasket so if you overfill the bowl, it all stays inside when you turn it on. The chute is SOOO nice - no more of the funky extra piece that my Cuisinart had that makes it VERY difficult to clean when you are done. When you use the disk, it is low enough that any vibrations are NOT going to reduce the life span of the bowl, but high enough for you to put a reasonable amount of stuff inside before needing to remove some to add more. When I made a smoothie with frozen strawberries, the machine did it absolutely effortlessly. The chopping blade is amazing - the amount of time it takes for this gadget to chop everything into beautiful tiny pieces is miniscule - I was still putting stuff in the top when I noticed how well everything was already chopped. It has suction cups on the bottom to hold it in place, which is also VERY nice, since my Cuisinart liked to take a tour of my countertops. All 3 accessories fit inside the food processor for storage (I don't know if the dough one would fit in there as well, but I will never use that). There are just a few things that I would like to see improved. The main one is that when you are done, all the lights start flashing. If you have sensory issues like I do, you may want to think twice before buying this - it make my heart start racing and I can't turn the thing off fast enough! I would like the chute to be wide enough that I could put a whole cucumber in it to be sliced. I would REALLY like another disk that could make thicker slices, and I totally understand that it wouldn't fit inside for storage. And it is going to take some time to get used to the pusher. It fits in the chute SO well, that when I first opened up the box, I thought it wasn't included - only to later realize that it was already on the pusher. And I am still having that trouble 2 weeks later - not realizing that it is there until I put something in the chute and nothing comes out - LOL. My Cuisinart's pusher was white plastic, so it was obvious, unlike this one that is made of the same material as the rest of it. But in general, I am very happy with my purchase and would highly recommend it. Oh - and one more thing. The bowl is higher than I am used to, and I was having trouble getting all the tiny garlic pieces off the sides of it. What I did was fill the bowl with water and dump it into a strainer. Ta da - the bottom of the strainer was full of the garlic, which I could easily put into my wok!
The best food processor! The only thing bad about this is that it works so great that I can't use it longer! It gets the job done so fast and it is definitely worth the money!
